method_note: Editorial decision support, not a verified performance or quality rating. Scores use only the fields on the official CSLB records, company-published service statements and the owner-supplied quote wording, each re-read on 2026-11-08. No provider was contacted, no reference was taken and no availability or price was confirmed.

weights.criterion: Combined plumbing + building capability on one licence
weights.basis: B + C-36 on the checked CSLB record is relevant to combined plumbing and building work, subject to BPC §7057 and the actual scope. A named, appropriately qualified restoration party and contract structure remain to be confirmed.

weights.criterion: Evidence of this specific scope (tub waste-and-overflow / overflow access)
weights.basis: Company-published case evidence, owner-supplied quote wording, or indexed review text. Every item is labelled by strength; none is proof of this exact stuck-lever job.

weights.criterion: Licence standing and tenure on the official CSLB record
weights.basis: Current-and-active status, years since issue, workers-compensation record, bond record and any additional status or complaint disclosure. Active status is not an endorsement.
Published company statements about HOA/property-manager work, property maintenance or occupied-home protocol. Absence of a statement scores low; it is not evidence of inability.

weights.criterion: Price evidence for a comparable scope
weights.basis: Only owner-supplied quote wording dated 2026-08-30 is available; those amounts are owner-reported and not verified. No provider has issued a document to this project.

ranked.name: Ace Plumbing & Rooter
ranked.why: Only candidate combining B + C-36 (plus A/C-4/C-16/C-10), active workers comp, a 2003 license date, published HOA/property-manager support, and BBB A+ Accreditation since 2004 with 0 complaints in 3 years. No exact trip-lever quote yet, and one 2023 Angi customer noted billing-itemization clarity; request an itemized combined written quote.
ranked.cost_note: No quote on file. Owner-supplied comparators for replacement-type scopes are $550 and $614 (owner-reported, unverified); the official DBI Category 1P plumbing fee is $290 if a permit applies (a fee, not a price).
ranked.ask: Confirm whether drywall/texture/paint after ceiling access is self-performed or subbed, request an itemized written estimate covering tub-side attempt, below-ceiling fallback and permit handling, and verify occupied-unit notice scheduling.
ranked.short_why: broadest single-licence coverage (B + C-36 plus A, C-4, C-16, C-10), active since 2003 with current workers comp and published HOA/property-manager work
ranked.review_evidence: RV-02 (bathtub-repair service mention; older occupied-home precautions account) and RV-12 (BBB A+ accredited since 2004) · no direct Yelp profile excerpt was found

ranked.name: Expert Plumbing Solutions
ranked.why: The supplied 2026-08-30 wording — "replace waste and overflow" — is the closest of the three owner-supplied scopes to the actual work, and the CSLB record has been active since 2012 with a current workers-compensation policy. C-36 only: the licence does not cover the ceiling repair, so a second licensed party is required if the ceiling is opened. This ranking does not endorse the $614 figure, which remains owner-reported.
ranked.cost_note: Owner-reported $614 on 2026-08-30 for "replace waste and overflow". Verified amount blank; no access route, drywall restoration, permit, cleanup or warranty line is included.
ranked.ask: Requote the identical combined scope and ask for the access method and the named restoration party in writing. Final verification gate: Confirm access route, parts, drywall, permit, cleanup, warranty and validity in writing.

ranked.review_evidence: RV-16 (BBB Not Rated, 0 complaints in 3 years) · no direct Yelp profile excerpt was found

ranked.review_evidence: RV-09 (bathtub and shower drain leak repair photos; apartment-specific account) · no direct Yelp profile excerpt was found
